resources.string: Using %1$s is at your own risk. This app can spend from the Spark wallet derived from your recovery phrase. You are fully responsible for the phrase, funds, and payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend using a wallet with a small spending balance.
Have the recovery phrase for the wallet you want %1$s to use ready.
Open the wallet or backup where your recovery phrase is stored.
Enter its 12 or 24 words in %1$s, in order.
%1$s opens that Spark wallet and protects the phrase with this device’s secure storage.
